messages:
Sam (AE): FYI HelixGrid legal just paused our POC kickoff. CFO requires explicit answers on: 1) Customer-managed keys (no key export), 2) IP allowlist + private peering for egress, 3) a short-term latency commitment for load tests. Need quick internal sync and an exec bridge tomorrow.
Rina (SE): Ack. Clarify: they require HSM-only with no key material leaving their appliance?
Sam (AE): Correct. They insist on HSM-only and that cryptographic ops remain on-prem.
Omar (Presales): Quick reality check: we don't offer direct HSM RPC peering as standard. Options: a) KMS proxy that forwards signing requests to their HSM over MTLS, b) temporary customer-managed KMS in cloud with strict key import controls. Both need security/legal.
Jess (SRE): From ops: load target is 700 qps, seq=128. Recommend Dedicated pool (2-3 GPUs) and warm canary. Internal perf sample for rw-v2-large seq128: p50=65ms p95=180ms. With 700 qps expect p95 to increase unless we enable aggressive batching and kv-cache.
Clara (Security): Security checklist: 1) HSM vendor FIPS cert, 2) network diagram, 3) threat model, 4) attestation form. Also need to know if they require egress to a specific egress gateway or IP range.
Ben (Legal): Legal: we can do a pilot-specific KMS addendum and limited SLA, but need procurement redlines. HSM peering will require a crypto addendum and liability carve-outs.
Sam (AE): They also requested a p95 <= 220ms during the 2-week POC. Is that doable?
Jess (SRE): p95 <=220ms is plausible with Dedicated + autoscale + tuning, but third-party HSM latency will affect tail latencies. Need to run an end-to-end smoke with a mocked HSM.
Rina (SE): I'll prepare two diagrams: direct HSM peering path vs KMS-proxy fallback and a short runbook for Okta/SCIM provisioning (they asked about SSO too).
Omar (Presales): Proposed timeline: Day 0-2 contract + KMS addendum; Day 3-5 network cert exchange + MTLS tests; Day 6-9 perf runs + tuning; Day 10 exec signoff. We can compress if they provide network access earlier.
Clara (Security): Action: I'll send the attestation template and request vendor certs and SOC contact.
Ben (Legal): I'll draft a short pilot SLA with credits capped and a crypto addendum draft. Sam, share any procurement redlines.
calendar-bot: Ticket created SLS-25121: "HelixGrid POC - HSM/KMS + private egress + pilot SLA" assigned to eng-oncall. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SLS-25121
Sam (AE): Can the team do an exec bridge tomorrow 11:00am PT? Customer insists on that slot.
Jess (SRE): 11:00am PT works. I'll run a staging smoke now and post quick numbers.
Rina (SE): I'll join and bring diagrams + runbook.
Omar (Presales): I'll prepare a 3-slide bridge deck: options, timeline, risks.
Clara (Security): I'll join for the attestation conversation.
Ben (Legal): Standby; will join if contract language is requested.
Sam (AE): Owners: Jess -> smoke perf run & ops checklist; Rina -> diagrams + SSO runbook; Omar -> bridge slides & timeline; Clara -> attestation & risk notes; Ben -> pilot SLA & addendum. I'll coordinate calendar and customer comms.
Rina (SE): Note: include `--kv-cache-enabled` and `--batch-policy=aggressive` in tuning recommendations.
Jess (SRE): Running `./smoke_test --model rw-v2-large --concurrency 700 --seq 128 --kv-cache` now; will paste snippet.
Sam (AE): If we can get perf data and draft SLA before 9:30am PT we can finalize slides. Escalate to me otherwise.
calendar-bot: Reminder scheduled: exec-bridge (HelixGrid) at 2025-06-10T18:00:00Z
Sam (AE): Reminder: HelixGrid will not trade key control for speed. Make the HSM path explicit and show the KMS-proxy as the contingency.
